confirm.title: Set up {name}
confirm.description:
Set up the fan at {address}? Home Assistant will connect to check that it responds.

**Connect when needed:** connects only to send a command or check the fan. Changes made with the remote show within about a minute.

**Stay connected:** changes made with the remote show at once, but it uses one Bluetooth connection slot all the time (most proxies have three).

You can change this later under Configure.

Not sure which fan this is? Blink its LEDs to find it.{note}

user.description: Choose a fan in range, or enter its Bluetooth address.

manual.description: Enter the fan's Bluetooth address, e.g. 34:CD:B0:C8:CD:26. The fan must be within range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy.

error.not_found: No fan with this address is in range.

abort.already_in_progress: This fan is already being added.
abort.not_supported: This device isn't a supported fan.

data_description.persistent: Changes made with the remote show at once, but it uses one Bluetooth connection slot all the time (most proxies have three). When off, it connects only to send a command or check the fan, and changes made with the remote show within about a minute.

device_busy.message: The fan is busy with another command. Try again.

not_found.message: The fan ({address}) isn't in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
